content: {"reasoning": "The claim is denied CO-197 for a missing prior authorization that was required at time of service. The payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those actions would be process mistakes. Resubmitting (clean/with records) would not cure an auth denial, and the balance stems from a provider auth failure so it cannot be billed to the patient. A formal appeal with a medical-necessity argument is the only legitimate recovery avenue on a denial that is on the table.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
